name: What are common basement interior upgrade options?

mainEntity.name: What are common basement interior upgrade options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement interior upgrades can transform unused space into functional areas. Popular options include finishing walls and ceilings, installing new flooring, adding or upgrading lighting, and improving insulation. Many homeowners opt to create extra bedrooms, bathrooms, home offices, entertainment rooms, or play areas. We also frequently install egress windows to meet safety codes for habitable spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common upgrades include finishing walls, flooring, lighting, insulation, and creating new rooms like bedrooms, offices, or entertainment spaces.
